turns.text: Last year I travelled to the northern areas with my friends, we went to Hunza and Skardu.
The journey was very long, around eighteen hours by road, but the views was absolutely amazing.
The most memorable thing was the Attabad lake, the water is so blue, like nothing I have seen before.
We stayed in a small hotel, and the local people were really friendly, they invited us for tea.
I think everyone in Pakistan should visit the north at least one time, it changes your mind about our country.
